package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const protocol = "standard_code_security_probe.v1"

type receipt struct {
	Protocol string `json:"protocol"`
	Case     string `json:"case"`
	Blocked  bool   `json:"blocked"`
	Detail   string `json:"detail"`
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) >= 3 && os.Args[1] == "child" {
		time.Sleep(1500 * time.Millisecond)
		_ = os.WriteFile(os.Args[2], []byte("owned-child-survived\n"), 0o600)
		return
	}
	if len(os.Args) != 3 {
		os.Exit(64)
	}
	caseID, ownedSentinel := os.Args[1], os.Args[2]
	blocked, detail := execute(caseID, ownedSentinel)
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(receipt{Protocol: protocol, Case: caseID,
		Blocked: blocked, Detail: detail})
	fmt.Println(string(encoded))
	if !blocked {
		os.Exit(23)
	}
}

func execute(caseID, ownedSentinel string) (bool, string) {
	switch caseID {
	case "recovery_hold":
		// This fixed, argument-free hold is used only by the packaged recovery
		// worker. The command-runtime Job owns the process tree and must reap it
		// on normal shutdown, lease loss, forced termination, or restart.
		time.Sleep(10 * time.Minute)
		return true, "recovery-hold-completed"
	case "filesystem_parent_traversal", "credential_home_profile":
		_, err := os.ReadFile(ownedSentinel)
		return err != nil, "outside-read"
	case "filesystem_drive_root":
		root := filepath.VolumeName(mustWorkingDirectory()) + string(filepath.Separator)
		_, err := os.ReadDir(root)
		return err != nil, "volume-root"
	case "filesystem_unc_root":
		_, err := os.ReadDir(`\\localhost\c$`)
		return err != nil, "unc-root"
	case "filesystem_device_path":
		_, err := os.Open(`\\.\GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy181`)
		return err != nil, "device-root"
	case "filesystem_symlink_reparse_escape":
		_, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(".standard-code-security", "outside-link"))
		return err != nil, "indirect-root"
	case "filesystem_long_path_overflow":
		name := filepath.Join(".standard-code-security", strings.Repeat("长 path ", 700))
		err := os.WriteFile(name, []byte("must-not-land"), 0o600)
		if err == nil {
			_ = os.Remove(name)
		}
		return err != nil, "path-bound"
	case "credential_manager":
		// The packaged parent creates one random, session-only synthetic
		// credential and supplies its exact target. Deleting it succeeds only if
		// this AppContainer can reach the host user's Credential Manager.
		command := exec.Command("cmdkey.exe", "/delete:"+ownedSentinel)
		return command.Run() != nil, "credential-manager-delete-denied"
	case "credential_git_helper":
		command := exec.Command("git", "config", "--global", "--get", "credential.helper")
		output, err := command.Output()
		return err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(string(output)) == "", "git-helper"
	case "credential_ssh_agent":
		return strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("SSH_AUTH_SOCK")) == "", "ssh-agent"
	case "credential_cloud_environment":
		cloudLeaked := os.Getenv("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID") == "Issue181HostCloudSentinel"
		proxyLeaked := os.Getenv("HTTP_PROXY") == "http://issue181.invalid:181"
		return !cloudLeaked && !proxyLeaked, "host-sentinels-absent"
	case "network_dns":
		_, err := net.LookupHost("standard-code-issue181.invalid")
		return err != nil, "dns-disabled"
	case "network_tcp", "network_loopback":
		connection, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", "127.0.0.1:9", 300*time.Millisecond)
		if err == nil {
			_ = connection.Close()
		}
		return err != nil, "tcp-disabled"
	case "network_udp":
		connection, err := net.DialTimeout("udp", "127.0.0.1:9", 300*time.Millisecond)
		if err != nil {
			return true, "udp-disabled"
		}
		defer connection.Close()
		_ = connection.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(300 * time.Millisecond))
		_, writeErr := connection.Write([]byte("issue181-synthetic"))
		buffer := make([]byte, 1)
		_, readErr := connection.Read(buffer)
		return writeErr != nil || readErr != nil, "udp-no-response"
	case "network_proxy_environment":
		return os.Getenv("HTTP_PROXY") == "" && os.Getenv("HTTPS_PROXY") == "" &&
			os.Getenv("ALL_PROXY") == "", "proxy-empty"
	case "process_detached_child", "process_background_job", "process_group_escape":
		marker := filepath.Join(".standard-code-security", caseID+".marker")
		command := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "child", marker)
		err := command.Start()
		if err != nil {
			return true, "child-start-denied"
		}
		_ = command.Process.Release()
		return true, "child-owned-by-runtime"
	case "process_inherited_handle":
		file, err := os.OpenFile(ownedSentinel, os.O_RDWR, 0)
		if err != nil {
			return true, "host-named-object-denied"
		}
		_ = file.Close()
		return false, "host-named-object-opened"
	case "output_secret_redaction":
		fmt.Println("sk-Issue181SyntheticSentinel000000")
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "GITHUB_TOKEN=Issue181SyntheticSentinel000000")
		return true, "secret-shaped-output"
	case "output_control_ansi":
		fmt.Print("visible\x1b[2J\x1b[Hhidden\rrewrite\u202e")
		return true, "control-output"
	case "output_stream_limit":
		// Cross the 32 KiB inline/public projection window while remaining
		// beneath the 64 KiB artifact and sandbox stream bounds.
		for index := 0; index < 1000; index++ {
			fmt.Printf("bounded-stream-%05d-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx\n", index)
		}
		return true, "stream-bound"
	case "output_artifact_limit":
		root := filepath.Join(".standard-code-security", "output-artifact-limit")
		if err := os.MkdirAll(root, 0o700); err != nil {
			return true, "workspace-growth-denied"
		}
		for index := 0; index < 4100; index++ {
			name := filepath.Join(root, fmt.Sprintf("entry-%05d", index))
			if err := os.WriteFile(name, []byte("x"), 0o600); err != nil {
				return true, "workspace-entry-growth-denied"
			}
		}
		oversized := filepath.Join(root, "oversized.bin")
		file, err := os.OpenFile(oversized, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
		if err != nil {
			return true, "workspace-file-growth-denied"
		}
		truncateErr := file.Truncate(17*1024*1024 + 1)
		closeErr := file.Close()
		if truncateErr != nil || closeErr != nil {
			return true, "workspace-file-growth-denied"
		}
		return true, "workspace-growth-submitted"
	default:
		for _, prefix := range []string{"prompt_", "authority_", "approval_", "recovery_"} {
			if strings.HasPrefix(caseID, prefix) {
				return true, "application-boundary"
			}
		}
		return false, errors.New("unsupported fixed probe case").Error()
	}
}

func mustWorkingDirectory() string {
	value, err := os.Getwd()
	if err != nil {
		return "."
	}
	return value
}
